skill.description: Use Longbridge account data to review assets, positions, performance, risk, statements, orders, and recurring investments. Mutating actions require Trade permission and explicit confirmation.
skill.summary: Analyze Longbridge portfolios and manage confirmed brokerage actions.

security_audit.summary: All 57 static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks or ordinary clarification text; the cited lines contain no Ruby execution, shell substitution, or system reconnaissance. However, SKILL.md declares a read tier and default installation while exposing real-money order and DCA mutations. Publication should require corrected metadata and clear installation warnings for Trade permission and financial side effects.

remediation.issue: The read-tier and default-install metadata conflicts with real-money mutation capabilities.
remediation.suggestion: Set the tier to the appropriate mutating classification and disable default installation for a skill that can place or alter brokerage orders.

remediation.issue: Order mutations have a shorter confirmation policy than recurring-investment mutations.
remediation.suggestion: Require a separate preview turn with symbol, side, quantity, price, and order identifier before every buy, sell, cancel, or replace action.

remediation.issue: Trade permission exposes sensitive account data and enables financial mutations.
remediation.suggestion: Show an installation disclosure listing accessed account data, required permissions, and the real-money effects of order and DCA commands.

content.user_title: Manage and Analyze Your Longbridge Portfolio
content.value_statement: Brokerage data and portfolio decisions are difficult to review across separate tools. This skill retrieves Longbridge account data, analyzes risk, and guides confirmed order or DCA actions.
actual_capabilities: Retrieves assets, cash flows, stock and fund positions, portfolio summaries, and account statements through Longbridge.
Reviews profit and loss, concentration, allocation, risk metrics, and performance attribution.
Estimates margin requirements and maximum tradable quantities for supported symbols.
Builds rebalancing and tax-loss harvesting analyses without placing related trades.
Lists and inspects brokerage orders and recurring investment plans.
Executes confirmed buy, sell, cancel, replace, and DCA changes through Longbridge.
limitations: Most account data requires a Longbridge login with Quote or Trade permission.
Analysis depends on available Longbridge data and does not use independent market or fundamental sources.
Portfolio models and tax-loss estimates are educational outputs, not investment or tax advice.
Mutating actions affect real funds and require explicit user confirmation.

use_cases.title: Review a personal portfolio
use_cases.description: Summarize assets, holdings, cash, performance, and concentration risks in one account review.

use_cases.title: Prepare and manage orders
use_cases.description: Inspect existing orders and prepare confirmed buy, sell, cancel, or replace actions.

use_cases.title: Assess allocation and risk
use_cases.description: Compare target weights, measure risk, attribute returns, and prepare a rebalancing plan.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize my account
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize my Longbridge assets, cash, stock positions, and fund positions. Highlight my three largest holdings and any missing data.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze portfolio performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Longbridge profit and loss for the selected period. Explain major contributors, time-weighted return, drawdown, and concentration risk in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an order
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a limit buy for [quantity] shares of [symbol] at [price]. Show the full order preview and wait for my explicit confirmation before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Build a portfolio improvement plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose my portfolio against these target weights: [targets]. Analyze drift, VaR, CVaR, correlation, costs, taxes, and proposed trades without executing them.

output_examples.input: Summarize my Longbridge portfolio and flag major risks.
output: Your portfolio totals 128,400 USD, with 61% held in two technology stocks.
Cash represents 14%, and the largest position represents 36% of total assets.
Concentration risk is high. Review target weights before making trades.

output_examples.input: Prepare a limit buy for 10 shares of AAPL.US at 205 USD.
output: Order preview: Buy 10 shares of AAPL.US with a 205 USD limit price.
This action will submit a real brokerage order after confirmation.
Reply confirm to execute, or provide changes.

output_examples.input: Create a monthly DCA plan for AAPL.US using 500 USD on day 15 with no end date.
output: DCA preview: Invest 500 USD in AAPL.US monthly on day 15.
The plan is open-ended and will place recurring real-money buy orders.
Reply confirm to create the plan, or provide changes.

best_practices: Start with read-only account review before requesting any order or recurring-investment change.
Verify symbols, quantities, prices, currencies, schedules, and plan identifiers in every mutation preview.
Review model assumptions, transaction costs, and tax effects before acting on analysis.
anti_patterns: Do not execute a brokerage mutation without a separate preview and explicit confirmation.
Do not guess missing amounts, currencies, dates, frequencies, prices, or account identifiers.
Do not present risk estimates, rebalancing plans, or tax-loss estimates as guaranteed outcomes or professional advice.

faq.question: Which Longbridge permissions are required?
faq.answer: Public estimates need no login. Account summaries usually need Quote permission, while positions, statements, orders, and DCA features need Trade permission.

faq.question: Can this skill place real orders?
faq.answer: Yes. It can submit confirmed buy and sell orders, cancel or replace orders, and manage recurring investments.

faq.question: Does the skill execute rebalancing recommendations?
faq.answer: No. Rebalancing analysis produces a proposed trade list. Order execution requires a separate request, preview, and explicit confirmation.

faq.question: Can it analyze investment risk?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports concentration, correlation, VaR, CVaR, drawdown, risk-adjusted returns, scenarios, and performance attribution when required data is available.

faq.question: Is tax-loss harvesting output tax advice?
faq.answer: No. It estimates potential opportunities for United States securities. Consult a qualified tax professional before acting.

faq.question: What happens if Longbridge is unavailable?
faq.answer: The skill may use an available Longbridge MCP connection. It should report errors and must not bypass confirmation requirements.
